alt.en: A cream book page with the number 411 at the top left and four stanzas of four lines, from "AND did those feet in ancient time" to "In England's green and pleasant land." There are no pictures.
alt.es: Página de libro color crema con el número 411 arriba a la izquierda y cuatro estrofas de cuatro versos, desde "AND did those feet in ancient time" hasta "In England's green and pleasant land." No hay imágenes.

caption.en: Blake's four stanzas as No. 411 of The Spirit of Man (1916), the wartime anthology of Robert Bridges, who that same year asked Parry for simple music to them.
caption.es: Las cuatro estrofas de Blake como el número 411 de The Spirit of Man (1916), la antología de guerra de Robert Bridges, que ese mismo año pidió a Parry una música sencilla para ellas.

source: Robert Bridges, ed., The Spirit of Man: An Anthology in English & French from the Philosophers & Poets (London: Longmans, Green, 1916), "England & Scotland", No. 411; cropped to poem 411 (the running head and poem 412 cut away)
library: University of Toronto, Robarts Library (digitized by the Internet Archive)
licenceEvidence: Printed London 1916; words by Blake (died 1827); editor Bridges died 1930. Internet Archive: possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT, "no visible notice of copyright; stated date is 1916" (see rights.md).
credit: University of Toronto, Robarts Library, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A page of printed music headed "AND DID THOSE FEET IN ANCIENT TIME", with "Stanzas from BLAKE'S "PROPHETIC BOOKS"" and "Set to Music by C. HUBERT H. PARRY", marked "Slow but with animation." A voice line marked "(SOLO.)" carries verse 1, from "And did those feet" to "A-mong those dark Sa-tan-ic", over a piano part on two staves, with two sharps in the key. At the foot: "Published by J. S. Curwen & Sons, Ltd."
alt.es: Página de música impresa con el encabezado "AND DID THOSE FEET IN ANCIENT TIME", con "Stanzas from BLAKE'S "PROPHETIC BOOKS"" y "Set to Music by C. HUBERT H. PARRY", y la indicación "Slow but with animation." Una línea de voz marcada "(SOLO.)" lleva la estrofa 1, desde "And did those feet" hasta "A-mong those dark Sa-tan-ic", sobre un acompañamiento de piano en dos pentagramas, con dos sostenidos en la armadura. Al pie: "Published by J. S. Curwen & Sons, Ltd."

caption.en: The first page of Parry's song as Curwen published it, reproduced in The Old Country (1917): verse 1 for a solo voice, "Slow but with animation", on the plate our arrangement is read from.
caption.es: La primera página de la canción de Parry tal como la publicó Curwen, reproducida en The Old Country (1917): la estrofa 1 para solista, "Slow but with animation", en la plancha de la que se lee nuestro arreglo.

source: Ernest Rhys, ed., The Old Country: A Book of Love & Praise of England (London: J. M. Dent & Sons, 1917), Parry's "And did those feet in ancient time" as published by J. S. Curwen & Sons, unnumbered plate, p. 18
callNumber: Internet Archive oldcountrybookof0000erne (no call number recorded)
licenceEvidence: Printed London 1917; music by Parry (died 1918), words by Blake (died 1827); editor Rhys died 1946. Faithful scan of a flat page adds no new copyright (see rights.md).

alt.en: The second page of the same music, with no title. After the word "mills?" the voice line is marked "(ALL AVAILABLE VOICES.)" and carries verse 2, from "Bring me my bow of burning gold!" to "In Eng-land's green and plea-sant land.", over a piano part on two staves, ending at a double bar.
alt.es: La segunda página de la misma música, sin título. Tras la palabra "mills?" la línea de voz lleva la indicación "(ALL AVAILABLE VOICES.)" y la estrofa 2, desde "Bring me my bow of burning gold!" hasta "In Eng-land's green and plea-sant land.", sobre un acompañamiento de piano en dos pentagramas, y termina en una doble barra.

caption.en: The plate's second page, where verse 2, "Bring me my bow of burning gold!", is marked for "ALL AVAILABLE VOICES": Bridges had asked for music an audience could join in.
caption.es: La segunda página de la plancha, donde la estrofa 2, "Bring me my bow of burning gold!", está marcada para "ALL AVAILABLE VOICES" (todas las voces disponibles): Bridges había pedido una música a la que el público pudiera sumarse.

source: Ernest Rhys, ed., The Old Country: A Book of Love & Praise of England (London: J. M. Dent & Sons, 1917), Parry's "And did those feet in ancient time" as published by J. S. Curwen & Sons, unnumbered plate, p. 19
